points.title: DIV completes with write
points.condition: pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr at completion of a DIV instruction (funct3=100).

points.title: DIVU completes with write
points.condition: pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr at completion of a DIVU instruction (funct3=101).

points.title: REM completes with write
points.condition: pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr at completion of a REM instruction (funct3=110).

points.title: REMU completes with write
points.condition: pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr at completion of a REMU instruction (funct3=111).

points.title: Wait asserted in first cycle of a division request
points.condition: First cycle of an outstanding division request with pcpi_wait=1.

points.title: Wait held on consecutive cycles
points.condition: Division request outstanding, pcpi_wait=1 in two consecutive cycles with pcpi_ready=0.

points.title: Wait still high after 16 cycles
points.condition: Division outstanding for at least 16 cycles, pcpi_wait=1 and pcpi_ready=0.

points.title: Wait still high after 31 cycles
points.condition: Division outstanding for at least 31 cycles, pcpi_wait=1 and pcpi_ready=0.

points.title: Completion in mid latency class
points.condition: Division completion after 16 to 31 cycles of being outstanding.

points.title: Completion in long latency class
points.condition: Division completion after 32 or more cycles outstanding.

points.title: DIV by zero
points.condition: DIV completes with rs2=0.

points.title: DIVU by zero
points.condition: DIVU completes with rs2=0.

points.title: REM by zero
points.condition: REM completes with rs2=0.

points.title: REMU by zero
points.condition: REMU completes with rs2=0.

points.title: DIV signed overflow
points.condition: DIV completes with rs1=0x80000000 and rs2=0xFFFFFFFF.

points.title: REM signed overflow
points.condition: REM completes with rs1=0x80000000 and rs2=0xFFFFFFFF.

points.title: DIV negative dividend positive divisor
points.condition: DIV completes with rs1 negative and rs2 positive nonzero.

points.title: DIV positive dividend negative divisor
points.condition: DIV completes with rs1 non-negative and rs2 negative, not the overflow case.

points.title: DIV both operands negative
points.condition: DIV completes with both rs1 and rs2 negative, not overflow.

points.title: REM negative dividend nonzero result
points.condition: REM completes with rs1 negative and nonzero result (rd negative).

points.title: REM positive dividend negative divisor nonzero result
points.condition: REM completes with rs1 positive, rs2 negative and nonzero result.

points.title: DIVU with high-bit dividend
points.condition: DIVU completes with rs1[31]=1 and rs2[31]=0, rs2 nonzero.

points.title: REMU dividend smaller than divisor
points.condition: REMU completes with 0 < rs2 and rs1 < rs2 (unsigned).

points.title: DIVU dividend smaller than divisor
points.condition: DIVU completes with rs2 nonzero and rs1 < rs2 (unsigned).

points.title: Equal operands
points.condition: Any division completes with rs1=rs2 and nonzero.

points.title: Divisor one
points.condition: Any division completes with rs2=1.

points.title: Zero dividend
points.condition: Any division completes with rs1=0 and rs2 nonzero.

points.title: Remainder exactly zero
points.condition: REM or REMU completes with rd=0, rs1 and rs2 nonzero (exact division).

points.title: Back-to-back division requests
points.condition: A new division request starts in the cycle right after pcpi_ready was seen.

points.title: Non-division instruction ignored
points.condition: pcpi_valid with a non-division instruction while pcpi_wait=0 and pcpi_ready=0.

points.title: Idle first cycle after reset
points.condition: First cycle after reset release with no valid and no wait, ready or wr.

points.title: Long idle after reset
points.condition: At least 8 consecutive quiet cycles with no valid and no wait, ready or wr.

points.title: Completion after reset during activity
points.condition: A division completes after a reset occurred while a request was outstanding.

points.title: Most negative dividend, other divisor
points.condition: Division completes with rs1=0x80000000 and rs2 neither 0 nor -1.

points.title: Signed division by minus one, non-overflow
points.condition: DIV or REM completes with rs2=0xFFFFFFFF and rs1 not 0x80000000.
